headline: SAFETY AWARD
chyron: STUDIO WINS AWARD FOR ZERO ACCIDENTS
ticker: BSN STUDIO NAMED "SAFEST IN THE REGION"
JUDGES VISITED ON TUESDAY, WHILE JEFF WAS ON HOLIDAY
CAREERCRASH.ORG: THE ELECTRICIAN SAYS IT WASN'T HIM

beats.text: Good evening! Tonight, a proud moment: this studio has won a national award for zero accidents.
The judges visited on Tuesday. Jeff, our technician, was on holiday.
Big shout-out to the crew. Jeff! Where are you, buddy?
Up here, Brock! On the lighting grid!
Jeff's the best in the business, Philippa. Thirty years and not once has he dropped a
(walks on. Picks up the light. Opens his mouth to speak. Closes it again.)
Great drop, Jeff! Real height on that one!
Brock, we are holding a safety award.
Don't worry, I've got the sandbag!
See, Philippa? Total professional. Jeff is a
Right. I'm giving the award back. Hand it OVER, Brock.

realStory.text: Made up. Workplace safety awards are real and well earned; this studio would not win one. Jeff is fine. Brock is fine. The lighting rig has been rehung, mostly.

signoff: Brock would like to thank Jeff for thirty great years. Jeff would like to apologise for the next thirty.
